_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking your values against longevity-optimized ranges…
_meta.openai/widgetDescription: PRISM preview card: out-of-range flags on synthetic values + link to the full evidence-graded report.

description: A fast first look at a few lab values, such as A1c, eGFR or LDL, showing which fall outside PRISM's reference ranges; not a diagnosis. Answers instantly (local check, no engine round-trip). For guideline-cited suggestions call analyze_biomarkers. For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). Inputs are not stored, except that a claim link, when offered, holds the submitted values for up to 30 minutes so the person can add them to their own account; unclaimed values are then deleted.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> value, e.g. {"HbA1c":6.1,"LDL-C":145}. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

name: quick_check

claim_panel.description: OPTIONAL owner handoff (present only when the consent bridge is enabled).

claim_url.description: One-click claim link — share ONLY with your owner.

expires_at_ms.description: Epoch ms when the unclaimed panel is hard-deleted.

name.description: Biomarker name as PRISM recognizes it.

status.description: One of: within / above / below longevity-optimized range.
